cohortDefinitions.name: All SINAN violence notifications
cohortDefinitions.rule: All violence notifications in SINAN with a valid occurrence date.

cohortDefinitions.name: Domestic or family violence
cohortDefinitions.rule: Residence location or a documented family/intimate relationship flag.

cohortDefinitions.name: Intimate partner violence
cohortDefinitions.rule: Current or former spouse/partner or boyfriend/girlfriend relationship flag.

notes: Domestic/family violence uses residence or documented family/intimate relationship flags.

Protection reports remain separate from SINAN notifications and are shown as a combined reporting signal because channel units are not validated as Disque 100 versus Ligue 180 in the available DuckDB table.
Policy and tax events are contextual time markers. They do not estimate a legal or tax effect on notifications, reports, consumption, or sales.
All browser datasets are aggregated; no row-level health records are exported.

policyEvents.title: Joana Maranhao Law
policyEvents.description: Changed limitation-period rules for sexual crimes against children and adolescents.

policyEvents.title: Carolina Dieckmann Law
policyEvents.description: Criminalized unauthorized access to computer devices; included as digital-abuse context.

policyEvents.title: Next Minute Law
policyEvents.description: Required immediate and comprehensive care for people subjected to sexual violence.

policyEvents.title: Femicide Law
policyEvents.description: Classified gender-motivated killing of women as qualified homicide and a heinous crime.

policyEvents.title: Liquor IPI Reform
policyEvents.description: Changed IPI treatment for specified alcoholic beverages.
policyEvents.verification_note: Relevant tax treatment applies from 1 January 2016.

policyEvents.title: Breach of Protective Orders Law
policyEvents.description: Criminalized breach of urgent judicial protective orders under the Maria da Penha Law.

policyEvents.title: Mariana Ferrer Law
policyEvents.description: Restricted demeaning or offensive conduct toward victims and witnesses in sexual-violence proceedings.

policyEvents.title: Henry Borel Law
policyEvents.description: Created protective measures and criminal provisions for violence against children and adolescents.

policyEvents.title: Nao e Nao Protocol
policyEvents.description: Created prevention and victim-support protocol for nightlife and entertainment venues.

policyEvents.title: Femicide Package Law
policyEvents.description: Expanded penalties and made femicide an autonomous criminal offense.

policyEvents.title: Deepfakes Anti-Abuse Law
policyEvents.description: Introduced stronger penalties for psychological violence using manipulated audio or video.
policyEvents.verification_note: Month-level marker supplied for the policy timeline; statutory effective date requires legal-source confirmation.

policyEvents.title: Vulnerable Welfare Reform
policyEvents.description: Increased penalties for mistreatment of vulnerable people, including children, older people, and people with disabilities.
policyEvents.verification_note: Month-level marker supplied for the policy timeline; statutory effective date requires legal-source confirmation.

policyEvents.title: Selective Tax Phase-In
policyEvents.description: Timeline context for the Selective Tax pilot described as applying to products harmful to public health, including alcoholic beverages.
policyEvents.verification_note: Month-level implementation-context marker supplied for the policy timeline; not a causal intervention estimate.

policyEvents.title: Vicarious Femicide Law
policyEvents.description: Added vicarious violence and related protections to the legal framework.
policyEvents.verification_note: Month-level marker supplied for the policy timeline.

policyEvents.title: National Abuse Registry Law
policyEvents.description: Created a national registry of persons convicted of violence against women.
policyEvents.verification_note: Month-level marker supplied for the policy timeline.
